We need to determine SMILES of unknown organic compound sample. We have no data yet. We can request spectra: mass spec, proton NMR, carbon NMR, IR, etc. Need to infer structure. Probably we need to use these tools to get data, then deduce SMILES.

We should start with mass spectrometry to get molecular weight. Use mass_spectrometry_spectra (no args). Let's call correctly.
